issues.legal_issue: The time limit for filing a written statement is directory, and a court may accept a late written statement when exceptional circumstances establish sufficient cause for the delay.
material_facts: The defendant sought permission to file a written statement after the period specified in Order 8 Rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure had expired.
The defendant said he had followed his trial counsel’s advice to wait for the decision of a pending appeal against an injunction before filing the written statement.
The appeal was being handled by another lawyer, who had the defendant’s case records, leaving the records unavailable to the lawyer conducting the suit at the trial court.
The defendant filed the written statement after obtaining the records and applying for condonation of the delay.
issues.conclusion: The delay was supported by sufficient cause in an exceptional situation. The application to condone the delay was allowed, the written statement was accepted, and the orders refusing it were set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Order 8 Rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure, including its proviso, is directory rather than mandatory. As held in Salem Advocate Bar Association, Tamil Nadu v. Union of India, AIR 2005 SC 3353, the word “shall” is not conclusive; the provision must be interpreted in light of its purpose and context. A court may accept a written statement after the stated period in exceptionally hard cases where sufficient cause is shown. Procedural rules should advance justice and should not be interpreted to leave a court powerless in extraordinary situations.

predicates.civil_suit_defendant_seeks_acceptance_of: A defendant in a civil suit seeks permission to file a written statement after the ordinary filing period has expired.
predicates.exceptional_cause_prevented_timely_filin: An exceptional circumstance, such as case records being held by counsel handling a pending appeal while the defendant followed counsel’s advice to wait, prevented timely filing.
predicates.late_written_statement_may_be_accepted: The court may accept the written statement despite its late filing.

issues.definition: When a defendant in a civil suit seeks to file a late written statement and an exceptional circumstance prevented timely filing, the court may accept it.
